metadata.purpose: Access security configurations, compliance policies, infrastructure code, and security scanning reports
use_cases: Read and analyze security configuration files
Review Infrastructure as Code for security issues
Analyze security scan results and vulnerability reports
Manage security runbooks and incident response playbooks

metadata.purpose: Manage security workflows, track vulnerabilities, and automate security checks in CI/CD pipelines
use_cases: Create and manage security scanning workflows
Review pull requests for security issues
Configure branch protection and security policies
metadata.setup_notes: Set GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable with a GitHub PAT that has repo, security_events, and workflow permissions

metadata.purpose: Access security best practices, compliance frameworks, threat intelligence, and security design patterns
use_cases: Query security best practices and standards
Access compliance framework requirements (SOC2, ISO27001, PCI-DSS)
Research threat intelligence and CVE information
Find security design patterns and architecture guidelines
Access cloud security documentation and guides
metadata.setup_notes: Set CONTEXT7_API_KEY environment variable. Get your API key from https://context7.com

GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: GitHub Personal Access Token with repo, security_events, and workflow permissions

CONTEXT7_API_KEY.description: Context7 API key for accessing security documentation and best practices

scan_integrations.sast: Configure SAST tools (Snyk, Checkmarx, Semgrep) in CI/CD pipelines
scan_integrations.dast: Configure DAST tools (OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite) for dynamic scanning
scan_integrations.sca: Configure Software Composition Analysis for dependency scanning
scan_integrations.container_scanning: Configure container image scanning (Trivy, Grype, Aqua)
scan_integrations.iac_scanning: Configure IaC security scanning (Checkov, tfsec, Terrascan)

monitoring_integrations.siem: Configure SIEM integration (Splunk, Elastic, Datadog Security Monitoring)
monitoring_integrations.cloud_security: Configure cloud security monitoring (AWS Security Hub, Azure Defender, GCP SCC)
monitoring_integrations.runtime_security: Configure runtime security (Falco, Sysdig, Aqua Runtime)

compliance_tools.policy_enforcement: Configure policy as code tools (OPA, Sentinel, Cloud Custodian)

recommended_setup.step_1: Install and configure filesystem MCP server for local security file access
recommended_setup.step_2: Set up GitHub MCP server with appropriate permissions for security workflow automation
recommended_setup.step_3: Configure Context7 MCP server for security knowledge base access
recommended_setup.step_4: Integrate security scanning tools in your CI/CD pipelines
recommended_setup.step_5: Set up security monitoring and alerting infrastructure
recommended_setup.step_6: Configure secrets management solution (HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager)
recommended_setup.step_7: Implement security policies and compliance automation

notes: Filesystem server is required for accessing local security configurations and reports
GitHub server is optional but recommended for automating security workflows
Context7 server is optional but helpful for accessing security best practices and documentation
Consider integrating additional security tools based on your specific requirements
Ensure proper authentication and authorization for all MCP server connections
Follow principle of least privilege when granting permissions to MCP servers
